_info: Unterseite Diamanten, Storyboard LRQ3 'Am Tresen'. Referenz = Storyboard-Blatt konzepte/LRQ3.png (vorschau/D3-diamanten.jpg). Motiv immer rechts, links dunkle Ruhe für Text. Keine Schrift im Bild.
STIL: Real photograph, full-frame camera, macro lens where needed, razor sharp, true-to-life colors, deep black and dark smoked glass, narrow slit of cool white light, platinum details, a luxury jewelry SHOP that sells and advises (never a workshop, no tools for making jewelry, no flame, no workbench). The left 45 percent of the frame is calm dark negative space. NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark, NO UI, NO frame numbers, no CGI look, no glow, no sparkle stars, no lens flares.
LRT1: Frame 1 of the reference storyboard as one single full-frame photograph: top view of a dark smoked-glass jewelry counter, a consultant's hands in thin black gloves on the right side unfold a small folded white diamond paper parcel, inside lies one loose round brilliant diamond about 1 carat that catches a narrow slit of white light, faint reflection in the glass.
LRT2: Frame 2 of the reference storyboard as one single full-frame photograph: extreme macro, polished steel diamond tweezers coming from the right hold one loose round brilliant diamond by its girdle, the stone large in the right half of the frame, every facet razor sharp, pure black background.
LRT3: Frame 3 of the reference storyboard as one single full-frame photograph: the view through a 10x jeweler's loupe, a round black vignette ring of the loupe barrel on the right side, inside the circle a round brilliant diamond seen face-up very large and sharp, the stone is perfectly clean without any inclusion, crystal clear facets, the rest of the frame black.
LRT4: Frame 4 of the reference storyboard as one single full-frame photograph: eight loose round brilliant diamonds of equal size in one straight horizontal row across the lower middle of the frame on a black velvet tray, from completely colorless on the left to a faint warm yellowish tint on the right (grading master stones D to K), soft even top light, no labels.
LRT5: Frame 5 of the reference storyboard as one single full-frame photograph: a woman's hand with natural nude manicure in the right half of the frame, one loose round brilliant diamond of about 1 carat placed on top of her ring finger to show the size on the finger, dark background, warm soft light on the skin, cool light on the stone.
LRT6: Frame 6 of the reference storyboard as one single photograph: one single loose round brilliant diamond seen exactly face-up from straight above, centered, perfectly sharp, lying on pure matte black, symmetrical arrows pattern visible, nothing else in the frame.
LRT7: Frame 7 of the reference storyboard as one single full-frame photograph: an open black velvet ring box standing on a dark smoked-glass counter in the right half of the frame, inside a white gold solitaire engagement ring with one round brilliant diamond in six claws, narrow slit of light on the stone, the lid inside is plain black velvet without any print.
LRT8: Frame 8 of the reference storyboard as one single full-frame photograph: a jewelry shop at evening, a young female customer seen from behind over her shoulder on the left, across the dark glass counter a friendly female consultant in a black blazer smiles and shows an open ring box, beside it a plain diamond grading report sheet without any readable text or brand, warm dim boutique light, dark vitrines in the background.
